//: IO Edge Subsystem - Level 3 (SiLens Edge Variant)
Minimal IO subsystem for embedded/industrial edge deployment.
Think 'sensor peripheral' - SPI slave to MCU host, I2C config, GPIO triggers.
No parallel bus, no DDR - just simple microcontroller-friendly interfaces.
Architecture:
MCU Host ←SPI Slave→ Image FIFO → Inference Engine
I2C Slave → Config Registers
GPIO → TRIG_IN, CLASS_OUT[3:0], BUSY, ERROR, IRQ_N
Target: ~5mm² on SKY130 (2250µm × 2250µm)
=== Clock ===
5ns = 200 MHz core clock
SPI clock is external, up to 50 MHz (handled internally)
=== Die Area ===
Target: ~5mm² = 2250µm × 2250µm
=== This is a MACRO, not top-level ===
=== Placement ===
Higher density OK - simpler design with less routing complexity
=== Synthesis ===
Aggressive area optimization for minimal footprint
=== Routing ===
=== IO Pin Count (minimal) ===
SPI Slave: 4 pins (SCLK, MOSI, MISO, CS#)
I2C Slave: 2 pins (SCL, SDA - open drain)
GPIO: 8 pins (TRIG_IN, CLASS[3:0], BUSY, ERROR, IRQ#)
Total: ~14 external interface pins (vs ~100 for VLM)
